params.caption: 🎮 Dune: Awakening now runs fully offline Funcom's former survival MMO has added its much-requested offline mode, so the game can now be played without an internet connection at any point. Even creating and deleting single-player characters no longer needs the web. It's the latest step in the game's shift away from MMO, after the single-player mode arrived earlier this year. 🕒 Nov 15, 2026 · 15:33 (GMT+3) 📰 Sources: PC Gamer · GamingOnLinux 🏜️ Back to Arrakis now?
